```{r utils}
# Data loading function
load_and_concatenate_files <- function(directory, pattern, sep, header = TRUE) {
  # List all files in the directory and subdirectories that match the pattern
  files <- list.files(path = directory, 
                      pattern = pattern, 
                      full.names = TRUE, 
                      recursive = TRUE)

  # Check if there are any files matching the pattern
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop("No files matching the pattern were found.")
  }

  # Read all matching CSV files into a list of data frames
  data_list <- lapply(files, 
                      read.csv, 
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                      sep = sep,
                      header = header)

  # Find the union of all column names
  all_columns <- Reduce(union, 
                        lapply(data_list, 
                               colnames))

  # Ensure all data frames have the same columns
  data_list <- lapply(data_list, function(df) {
    missing_cols <- setdiff(all_columns, 
                            colnames(df))
    df[missing_cols] <- 0
    return(df[all_columns])
  })

  # Concatenate all data frames
  combined_data <- do.call(rbind, 
                           data_list)

  return(combined_data)
}

# Merged chunked data
merge_chunk_columns <- function(df) {
  # Get column names
  col_names <- colnames(df)
  
  # Create a pattern to match the chunk columns
  chunk_pattern <- "_chunk_\\d+"
  
  # Extract base names without chunk patterns
  base_names <- gsub(chunk_pattern, 
                     "", 
                     col_names)
  
  # Initialize result dataframe with same number of rows as input
  result_df <- data.frame(row.names = row.names(df))
  
  # Get unique base names
  unique_base_names <- unique(base_names)
  
  # For each unique base name, merge related columns
  for (base_name in unique_base_names) {
    # Find all columns related to this base name
    related_indices <- which(base_names == base_name)
    related_cols <- col_names[related_indices]
    
    # Skip empty base names
    if (base_name == "")
      next
    
    # If there's only one column with this base name and it doesn't have a chunk pattern
    if (length(related_cols) == 1 && !grepl(chunk_pattern, 
                                            related_cols)) {
      # Just copy the column as is
      result_df[[base_name]] <- df[[related_cols]]
    } else {
      # Sum the values of all related columns
      result_df[[base_name]] <- rowSums(df[, 
                                           related_cols, 
                                           drop = FALSE], 
                                        na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  return(result_df)
}

create_key_file <- function(input_table) {
  # Check if the input table has the required structure
  if (ncol(input_table) < 2) {
    stop("Input table must have at least 2 columns (keys and at least one file)")
  }
  
  # Extract keys (first column)
  keys <- input_table[, 1]
  
  # Get file names from column headers (excluding the first column)
  file_names <- colnames(input_table)[-1]
  file_names <- gsub("\\.", "-", file_names)
  
  # Initialize empty result dataframe
  result <- data.frame(circ_id = character(), 
                       file_name = character(), 
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # For each file (column), find keys with values > 0
  for (file_idx in 1:length(file_names)) {
    fileName <- file_names[file_idx]
    # Column index is file_idx + 1 because the first column contains keys
    values <- input_table[, file_idx + 1]
    
    # Find indices where the value is > 0
    positive_indices <- which(values > 0)
    
    if (length(positive_indices) > 0) {
      # Add rows to result for each key with positive value
      new_rows <- data.frame(
        circ_id = keys[positive_indices],
        file_name = fileName,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      result <- rbind(result, new_rows)
    }
  }
  # Return the result dataframe
  return(result)
}
```

```{r file_key}
# Load expression data
expDf <- load_and_concatenate_files(projPath,
                                    ".expression",
                                    "\t")
# Merge chunked columns
expDf <- merge_chunk_columns(expDf)

# Create key file
keyDf <- create_key_file(expDf)
```

```{r circRNA_master}
# Load Collapsed_info_master
circRNADf <- load_and_concatenate_files(projPath,
                                     "\\.info",
                                     "\t",
                                     header = FALSE)

# Transform the data frame to the desired format
circRNADf <- circRNADf %>%
  # Extract basic information from V1-V8
  mutate(
    chr = V1,
    start = as.numeric(V4),
    end = as.numeric(V5),
    count = as.numeric(V6),
    strand = V7
  ) %>%
  # Extract information from V9
  mutate(
    # Extract circ_id from the beginning of V9
    circ_id = gsub("circ_id (.*?);.*", "\\1", V9),
    # Extract splice_site
    splice_site = gsub(".*splice_site (.*?);.*", "\\1", V9),
    # Extract equivalent_seq
    equivalent_seq = gsub(".*equivalent_seq (.*?);.*", "\\1", V9),
    # Extract circ_type
    circ_type = gsub(".*circ_type (.*?);.*", "\\1", V9),
    # Extract circ_len
    circ_len = as.numeric(gsub(".*circ_len (.*?);.*", "\\1", V9)),
    # Extract isoform
    isoform = gsub(".*isoform (.*?);.*", "\\1", V9),
    # Extract gene_id - handle missing values
    gene_id = ifelse(grepl("gene_id", V9), 
                    gsub(".*gene_id (.*?);.*", "\\1", V9),
                    NA_character_),
    # Extract gene_name - handle missing values
    gene_name = ifelse(grepl("gene_name", V9),
                      gsub(".*gene_name (.*?);.*", "\\1", V9),
                      NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  # Select only the desired columns in the specified order
  select(chr, start, end, count, strand, circ_id, splice_site, equivalent_seq,
         circ_type, circ_len, isoform, gene_id, gene_name)

# Check for circRNAs in circRNADf that don't have a match in metaKeyDf
missing_in_metaKeyDf <- circRNADf$circ_id[!circRNADf$circ_id %in% metaKeyDf$circ_id]
if (length(missing_in_metaKeyDf) > 0) {
  cat("CircRNAs in circRNADf that don't have a match in metaKeyDf:\n")
  print(missing_in_metaKeyDf)
} else {
  cat("All circRNAs in circRNADf have a match in metaKeyDf.\n")
}

# Check for circRNAs in metaKeyDf that don't have a match in circRNADf
missing_in_circRNADf <- metaKeyDf$circ_id[!metaKeyDf$circ_id %in% circRNADf$circ_id]
if (length(missing_in_circRNADf) > 0) {
  cat("CircRNAs in metaKeyDf that don't have a match in circRNADf:\n")
  print(missing_in_circRNADf)
} else {
  cat("All circRNAs in metaKeyDf have a match in circRNADf.\n")
}

# Rename circ_ID to circ_id in expDf
expDf <- expDf %>%
  rename_with(~"circ_id", .cols = "circ_ID")

# Transform expDf from wide to long format to get per-sample counts
expDf_long <- expDf %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -circ_id,
               names_to = "file_name",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  # Replace dots with dashes in file_name to match metadata
  mutate(file_name = gsub("\\.", "-", file_name))

# Merge circRNA data with metadata first
circRNADf <- merge(circRNADf,
                   metaKeyDf,
                   by = "circ_id")

# Merge with expression data to get correct per-sample counts
circRNADf <- merge(circRNADf,
                   expDf_long,
                   by = c("circ_id", "file_name"))

# Remove the old count column and rename the new one
circRNADf <- circRNADf %>%
  select(-count.x) %>%
  rename_with(~"count", .cols = "count.y")

# Remove circRNA without a canonical splice signal.
circRNADf <- circRNADf[circRNADf$splice_site != "None",]

write.table(circRNADf, 
            file = paste0(projPath, "/circRNA_master.tsv"), 
            sep = "\t", 
            row.names = FALSE, 
            quote = FALSE)
```

```{r create_circRNA_gtf}
# Create a GTF file from circRNADf
circRNADf_gtf <- circRNADf %>%
  # Split isoforms into separate rows while preserving strand
  separate_rows(isoform, sep = "\\|") %>%
  # Split each isoform into its exons
  mutate(exon_list = strsplit(isoform, ",")) %>%
  # Create a row for each exon
  unnest(exon_list) %>%
  # Split exon coordinates into start and end
  separate(exon_list, into = c("exon_start", "exon_end"), sep = "-", convert = TRUE) %>%
  # First group by circ_id to create unique isoform numbers for each circRNA
  group_by(circ_id) %>%
  mutate(isoform_num = as.numeric(factor(isoform, levels = unique(isoform)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Then group by circ_id and isoform for transcript information
  group_by(circ_id, isoform, strand) %>%
  mutate(
    transcript_id = paste0(circ_id, "-isoform", isoform_num),
    # Create exon numbers within each transcript
    exon_number = row_number(),
    # Create attributes column
    attributes = paste0(
      'gene_id "', transcript_id, '"; ',
      'transcript_id "', transcript_id, '"; ',
      'exon_number "', exon_number, '"; ',
      'gene_name "', transcript_id, '"; ',
      'circ_type "', circ_type, '"; ',
      'count "', count, '";'
    ),
    # Add source and feature columns
    source = "Ouroseq",
    feature = "exon",
    score = ".",
    frame = "."
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Select and arrange columns for GTF format
  select(
    chr,
    source,
    feature,
    exon_start,
    exon_end,
    score,
    strand,
    frame,
    attributes,
    transcript_id,
    exon_number
  ) %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, exon_number) %>%
  # Remove temporary columns after arranging
  select(-transcript_id, -exon_number)

# Write the GTF file
write.table(circRNADf_gtf, 
            file = paste0(projPath, "/circRNA_master.gtf"), 
            sep = "\t", 
            row.names = FALSE, 
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)
```

```{r cpc2_master}
                   col = X.ID,

                   sep = "\\|")

# Function to extract coding peptide sequences to FASTA file
extract_coding_peptides_to_fasta <- function(df, output_file) {
  # Filter for coding sequences
  coding_df <- df[df$label == "coding", ]
  
  # Check if there are any coding sequences
  if (nrow(coding_df) == 0) {
    cat("No coding sequences found. Creating empty FASTA file.\n")
    file.create(output_file)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Check if putative_peptide column exists
  if (!"putative_peptide" %in% colnames(coding_df)) {
    stop("putative_peptide column not found in the data frame.")
  }
  
  # Remove rows with missing or invalid peptide sequences
  coding_df <- coding_df[!is.na(coding_df$putative_peptide) & 
                         coding_df$putative_peptide != "" & 
                         coding_df$putative_peptide != "non", ]
  
  if (nrow(coding_df) == 0) {
    cat("No valid peptide sequences found. Creating empty FASTA file.\n")
    file.create(output_file)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Open file for writing
  fasta_file <- file(output_file, "w")
  
  # Write each sequence to FASTA format
  for (i in 1:nrow(coding_df)) {
    # Write header (circ_id)
    writeLines(paste0(">", coding_df$circ_id[i]), fasta_file)
    # Write sequence
    writeLines(coding_df$putative_peptide[i], fasta_file)
  }
  
  # Close file
  close(fasta_file)
  
  cat(paste0("Extracted ", nrow(coding_df), " coding peptide sequences to ", output_file, "\n"))
}

# Extract coding peptides to FASTA file
extract_coding_peptides_to_fasta(masterCpc2Df, 
                                  paste0(projPath, "/CPC2_coding_peptides.fasta"))

```
